items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS completeness, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown; data quality is yellow for analytics permissions or collector errors. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, continue only the existing bounded read-only security evidence work, and permit ordinary reversible growth only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence work item only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work or alter production state.
